title: SIU clears Windsor police in man's death
article: The province's Special Investigations Unit has cleared Windsor police of any wrongdoing in the June 2004 death of a man in their custody.
Craig Morency, 36, was arrested at a doughnut shop on June 22, 2004 on suspicion of breaking into a nearby car.
He was placed in a cell but died later that day in hospital after showing signs of medical distress, the investigations unit said in a statement released Monday.

Morency was in reasonable physical condition and did not display any symptoms of impairment prior to being jailed, said the agency, which investigates all incidents involving police that have resulted in serious injury or death.
"Although Morency's exact cause of death has not been determined, this unit has ruled out any cause that could be attributed to police conduct," said director James Corning.
